correctness.rationale: Monteiro--Stasinski supply all nonlinear center-trivial constituents in the Steinberg square. Self-duality puts every missing linear character into the cube via its Steinberg twist. For nonlinear targets, an all-linear decomposition of chi times Steinberg would make Steinberg scalar on the derived subgroup; the cyclic abelian quotient would then force an abelian image, contradicting nonlinear irreducibility. A nontrivial center-trivial determinant twist is absent from the square when gcd(n,q-1)>1, proving sharpness.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2013 literature covers simple-group Steinberg squares and the September 2026 source proves nonlinear coverage for GL_n(q) while noting missing linear characters. Targeted searches found no exact 2/3 Steinberg covering-number formula for PGL_n(q), no Steinberg-cube statement, and no matching cyclic-abelianization completion lemma.

value.rationale: The result gives the exact tensor exponent for the canonical Steinberg character, shows that failure of the square in the non-simple projective case costs exactly one factor, and isolates a reusable cube-completion mechanism for groups with cyclic abelianization.
